quote.text: The money is in the follow-up.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls scheduled — check Calendly for any new bookings.
focus: Inbox is dry on prospects for a third straight day, so volume isn't the problem — follow-up is. Open GHL, pull the 5 freshest of your 27+ FB leads, and send each a direct booking-link text before noon. Zero of 27 have closed; unworked leads decay fast.

FB Ads are still spending ~$35/day at a $17 CPL with zero closes. Open Ads Manager and trace the funnel: are forms filling but nobody booking? If lead volume is fine but bookings are zero, the leak is the offer or the follow-up cadence, not the ad.

Outbound is running on one leg — Instantly billing lapsed, LinkedIn paused, Bland never launched, only FB group posts auto-fire at 9 AM. Reactivate one channel today: restore Instantly billing or send 10 manual DMs. A single source is fragile when it's already producing zero closes.
gmail_summary: No prospect replies or warm conversations. Inbox is entirely routine: a BofA mobile check deposit ($355), Capital One statement-credit and statement-ready alerts, an Apple receipt, plus retail and crypto newsletters. Nothing business-critical or urgent.
